description: Program-office analytics for Project Phoenix: data-migration quality, test execution, training readiness and cutover readiness for the Wave 1 S/4HANA go-live.

items.description: Bronze/silver/gold lakehouse landing the ECC + S/4HANA extracts, the Migration Cockpit run logs, the test-management export and the learning-portal feed.
Migration-object pass rates per mock load, defect backlog and the >=98% Mock 4 gate. Sourced from the Migration Cockpit reconciliation tables in PhoenixLakehouse.
Planned vs executed vs passed test cases per workstream per week across SIT-1, SIT-2 and UAT, with open Sev-1/Sev-2 defects against each phase exit gate.
Role-based curriculum assignment and completion per Wave 1 site and role family, against the >=95% go/no-go gate and the >=90% sandbox pass rate for critical roles.
Per-plant cutover readiness score, open cutover-register actions, site lead and RAG status for both waves. The Steering go/no-go view.
One-page monthly Steering view: wave RAG, readiness by plant, gate status across all four models.
Mock-load drilldown per migration object and object owner: pass-rate trend, defect ageing and distance to the 98% rule.
Weekly PMO Sync view: SIT/UAT burn-up per workstream next to curriculum completion per site and role family.
Real-time eventhouse for the cutover weekend: Migration Cockpit job events, interface heartbeats and war-room task state. Idle until the December blackout.
